patch_description:
This implementation uses a deterministic active-constraint exchange search rather than returning a fixed lattice or relying on a generic optimizer. Points are represented in barycentric coordinates, which makes every proposed point automatically projectable into the equilateral triangle.

The search fixes the three triangle vertices and optimizes the other eight points. At each iteration it identifies the movable point participating most heavily in the currently smallest triangles, generates a batch of local and occasional global barycentric proposals for that point, and retains the proposal maximizing a smooth lower-tail objective over all triangle areas. Several fixed-seed restarts and decreasing proposal scales provide deterministic coarse-to-fine exploration. The final returned arrangement is selected by its true minimum normalized triangle area.
